subsystems.failure: CRITICAL DEFECT: PLL cannot converge to ANY tempo other than its hardcoded initial 150 BPM. Tests PLL-2A (120 BPM), PLL-2B-130, PLL-2B-140 all return finalBpm≈149.5 (locked=true, but locked to wrong tempo). PLL-2C (25% missing beats) bpmErr=4.90. PLL-2D (extra transients) bpmErr=4.66. PLL-2E (tempo jump 120→145) bpmMid=bpmEnd=149.36 (PLL NEVER adapts to the new tempo). PLL-2F (±5ms jitter) bpmErr=4.84. Root cause: tempoGain=0.025 too small AND the observedPeriod guard (line 72: observedPeriod < 60/80) rejects the corrected-period computation because the just-corrected beatTime lags behind true beat times, producing a doubled period.
